pil_structure.correction: An earlier checker assumed the ZAP MDT/ELF should be AARCH64 (0xb7). That was a CHECKER defect, not a firmware defect: the ZAP shader is a Qualcomm Hexagon DSP ELF32 image (EM_HEXAGON 0xa4), as confirmed against Linux v6.12 elf-em.h. The corrected check is stronger: it ties every .bNN size to the ELF program header.
